// diagnostic

E3513

Dependency `{package}` now reaches `{effect_name}`, which `.jet/lock` doesn't record for it.

What

Dependency `{package}` now reaches `{effect_name}`, which `.jet/lock` doesn't record for it.

Why

`--locked` requires each dependency's inferred effect row to stay within the row the project lock records.

Fix

Review the change to `{package}`, then rerun without `--locked` to record its wider row.

Worked example
